description: A painted interior of a dark wooden round room with a lit candle. Two men sit across a round wooden table. The man on the left wears a grey wrapped turban, a beard and a dark robe with thick fur trim. The man on the right has long dark curled hair, a white lace cravat and a dark coat with gold braid. He holds a quill over two sheets of paper with red wax seals. An inkwell sits on the table. No visible text, and the painting runs to the edges with no frame.
